_note: Scripted Risk flags for vendor-agreement-01. Listed out of document order on purpose. The first six quote the document exactly and are shown. The last five must be withheld: ninety changed to sixty, an invented sentence, two sentences with one invented, two clauses spliced with an ellipsis, and a sentence cut off before its end.

riskFlags.title: Late payment interest
riskFlags.says: Any amount not paid on time carries interest at 2% a month.
sourceSentences: Customer will pay interest at 2% per month on any amount not paid on time.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Customer will pay interest at 2% per month only on an amount that is not paid within seven days of the invoice date.

riskFlags.title: Paying out the rest of the term to leave early
riskFlags.says: If Tulsi Tiffin House ends the agreement before a term is over, it pays the monthly fee for every month left in that term.
riskFlags.judgment: Paying out the whole remaining term is a larger exit cost than a cleaning contract usually carries.
sourceSentences: If Customer ends this Agreement before the end of a term, Customer will pay Vendor the monthly fee for every month left in that term.
riskFlags.counterOffer: If Customer ends this Agreement before the end of a term, Customer will pay Vendor the monthly fee for one month only.

riskFlags.title: Indemnity for the condition of the premises
riskFlags.says: Tulsi Tiffin House covers Kesari against all claims arising from the condition of its premises.
sourceSentences: Customer will indemnify Vendor against all claims arising from the condition of Customer's premises.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Customer's total liability under its indemnity for claims arising from the condition of Customer's premises will not exceed one month's fee.

riskFlags.title: Two-year renewal unless notice is given ninety days ahead
riskFlags.says: The agreement runs for two years and then renews for two more unless Tulsi Tiffin House gives written notice at least ninety days before the term ends.
sourceSentences: This Agreement starts on 1 December 2026 and runs for two years.
It renews automatically for further two-year terms unless Customer gives written notice at least ninety days before the end of a term.
riskFlags.counterOffer: This Agreement starts on 1 December 2026 and runs for two years. It renews for a further two-year term only if Customer gives written notice at least ninety days before the end of a term.

riskFlags.title: Liability capped at one month's fee
riskFlags.says: Kesari's total liability under the agreement is capped at one month's fee.
riskFlags.judgment: A cap this low is not standard for a contract that runs two years.
sourceSentences: Vendor's total liability under this Agreement will not exceed one month's fee.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Vendor's total liability under this Agreement will not exceed the monthly fees for a full two-year term.

riskFlags.title: Fee rises at each renewal
riskFlags.says: Kesari can raise the monthly fee by up to 10% at each renewal.
sourceSentences: Vendor may increase the monthly fee by up to 10% at each renewal.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Vendor will not increase the monthly fee by more than 10% at a renewal, and only by written notice at least ninety days before the end of a term.

riskFlags.title: Sixty-day renewal notice
riskFlags.says: Tulsi Tiffin House has to give notice sixty days before the term ends.
sourceSentences: It renews automatically for further two-year terms unless Customer gives written notice at least sixty days before the end of a term.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Customer gives written notice at least thirty days before the end of a term.

riskFlags.title: Personal guarantee
riskFlags.says: Tulsi Tiffin House's partners personally guarantee every payment.
sourceSentences: Customer personally guarantees all payments due under this Agreement.
riskFlags.counterOffer: No partner of Customer guarantees any payment due under this Agreement.

riskFlags.title: Services stop over an unpaid invoice
riskFlags.says: Each invoice is due in seven days, and Kesari stops cleaning while one is unpaid.
sourceSentences: Customer will pay each invoice within seven days of the invoice date.
Vendor may suspend the Services if any invoice is unpaid.
riskFlags.counterOffer: Vendor continues the Services while an invoice is unpaid.

riskFlags.title: Fee and increases
riskFlags.says: The fee is Rs. 18,000 a month and rises by up to 10% at each renewal.
sourceSentences: Customer will pay Vendor Rs. 18,000 per month ... at each renewal.
riskFlags.counterOffer: The fee stays at Rs. 18,000 per month for every term.

riskFlags.title: Automatic renewal
riskFlags.says: The agreement renews by itself for further two-year terms.
sourceSentences: It renews automatically for further two-year terms
riskFlags.counterOffer: This Agreement ends at the end of its term.
